671:t_017:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I fight to protect you... My wings fly carrying your feelings! Always, from now on too!」

671:t_018:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You...! A man who toys with love!」

671:t_018:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I always fly for real! Toward what I aim for!」

671:t_018:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$'s the same! Even without me, she has her song!」

671:t_018:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「So I will protect her song, even if I can't be at her side!」

671:t_018:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Reach out your hand, $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_019:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
「$$アルト$$! I believed you'd come to save me!」

671:t_019:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Just as I told you my feelings, I want you to be honest about yours too, $$アルト$$.」

671:t_019:7.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'll keep singing from now on... Because you protected my song, $$アルト$$.」

671:t_020:1.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! We will embrace your sorrow!」

671:t_021:0.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$エレメント$$ Change! $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$, to $$ゲパルト$$!」

671:t_022:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So this is... love! The heart that makes everyone happy!」

671:t_024:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I can tell...! $$ミカゲ$$'s closed-off heart moved, just a little!」

671:t_024:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Heh... So you do understand what love is, after all.」

671:t_024:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I won't accept it! I won't accept something like this!」

671:t_025:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... There's no escape for you in this space.」

671:t_026:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the heck was that!?」

671:t_026:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「A palm appeared first, and then an arm stretched out from it toward the body!」

671:t_026:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's his technique! He's reversing causality... in other words, cause and effect!」

671:t_026:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So the attack, the cause, happens after the result of the hit!」

671:t_026:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「There's no way to dodge that!」

671:t_026:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「There's no way to dodge that!」

671:t_026:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「There's no way to dodge that!」

671:t_026:7.en:
$$桂$$
「The best defense is a good offense! We have no choice but to take him down before he gets us!」

671:t_026:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you think such a shallow scheme will work on me?」

671:t_027:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Exactly. You can't even catch my shadow.」

671:t_027:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「An attack that can't be dodged, and footwork that appears and vanishes at will!」

671:t_027:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「How are we supposed to fight an enemy like that!?」

671:t_027:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't lose heart! He's staying close on purpose to provoke us. He doesn't seem to want to jump that far away!」

671:t_027:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then we just have to keep up with his movements!」

671:t_027:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh heh... Without wings, you Wingless can't jump.」

671:t_027:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll teach you that arrogance of yours will be your undoing!」

671:t_027:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Futile, Wingless. My triangle of love, hatred and despair is stronger than steel.」

671:t_027:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Whatever a bunch like you does, you can never shatter these feelings!」

671:t_100:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「After all, children could never understand my love, my hatred, or my despair.」

671:t_100:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's true, I'm a kid... I don't really understand what it's like to love someone...」

671:t_100:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But I do know one thing: you're evil!」

671:t_100:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't condemn the $$天翅$$ that I am as evil by a Wingless yardstick!」

671:t_100:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It doesn't matter if you're an $$天翅$$ or a human! A bad guy is a bad guy, and our enemy!」

671:t_101:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Twins of light and darkness! Don't talk as if you know!」

671:t_101:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your love hurts people! How can something like that be love!」

671:t_101:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you have feelings of cherishing someone, they should give rise to boundless kindness!」

671:t_101:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! Then let this battle show which will envelop the world, your love or my hatred!」

671:t_102:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The feeling of loving someone has the power to blow hatred away somewhere!」

671:t_102:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Spiral Man! Do you mean to deny my love!」

671:t_102:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「I don't mean to! But if you're going to wreck our love... the world $$ニア$$ and I love, that's a different story!」

671:t_102:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I swear it on this drill! Our love won't lose to your busted love!」

671:t_102:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! What awaits beyond Tengen Toppa is the Heavenly Prison... Before you get there, you will die here!」

671:t_103:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Big Sis and $$コーチ$$'s love was strong and gentle, and it gave us courage!」

671:t_103:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「But your love makes the world unhappy!」

671:t_103:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't speak of a Wingless' love in the same breath as mine!」

671:t_103:3.en:
$$カズミ$$
「A person who can't forgive anyone is pitiful...」

671:t_103:5.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That's why we'll save you! By shattering your hatred!」

671:t_103:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then we'll show you! The power of humans... and our feelings!」

671:t_103:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And we'll make you remember, too! The true power of love!」

671:t_104:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A machine like you could never understand the depth of my feelings!」

671:t_104:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's true, $$ノノ$$ has a machine body. But a burning heart lives inside it!」

671:t_104:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「It's true, $$ノノ$$ has a machine body. But a burning heart lives inside it!」
